top_reforms.description: Four-stage reform: tightened job-search conditionality, merged unemployment assistance and social aid (Hartz IV), expanded temporary work agencies, created mini-job categories.
top_reforms.outcome: Unemployment fell from ~11% (2005) to ~3% (2019); 'German jobs miracle'; real wage growth initially suppressed but recovered.

top_reforms.description: Renewable Energy Act (EEG) 2000 set feed-in tariffs; subsequent reforms moved to auction-based CfDs; phase-out of nuclear (completed 2023).
top_reforms.outcome: Renewable share of electricity ~55% by 2023; created global export industries in solar, wind technology; energy costs initially raised.

top_reforms.description: Solidarity surcharge financed eastern reconstruction; Schuldenbremse (debt brake) constitutionalised from 2009; structural surplus achieved by 2014.
top_reforms.outcome: Eastern productivity convergence (still incomplete); constitutional fiscal discipline; debt fell from ~80% to ~60% GDP pre-pandemic.
